job: Copy one command or one value, or follow a short list of numbered commands.
purpose: A one-line well with a mono value and a copy button: an install line, a skill URL, a key. The $ prompt is decoration and is never copied. fd-snippet-em marks the one segment that matters; fd-snippet-dim quiets the rest. Numbered steps put a title, a hint and a snippet under each number; a done step shows a check.
useWhen: A reader leaves with one command: install, login, run.
Setup takes several commands that should be numbered.
A key or skill URL shows in an accent well.

avoidWhen.when: Several lines of code or a file.
A secret that stays hidden until revealed.
A form field the reader can edit.

states.name: next step shown
states.how: data-copy-next: after Copy the step shows in the fd-copy-next line under the snippet (data-state="shown")

states.name: step done
states.how: data-state="done" on a step; its number becomes a check

variants.useWhen: A tinted well for keys and skill URLs.
A setup command or a prompt whose next step a first-time user gets wrong: it shows in an fd-copy-next line under the snippet once Copy is pressed.

parts.role: The $ prompt; not selectable, never copied.

keyboard.does: On the copy button, copies the value.
